# nonGridRangeSameDimensions

<link-summary>Checks whether two grid ranges differ in height or width.</link-summary>

<web-summary>nonGridRangeSameDimensions() — Checks whether two grid ranges differ in height or width. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function nonGridRangeSameDimensions(range1: GridRange, range2: GridRange): boolean;
```

The negation of `isGridRangeSameDimensions`, for the guard clause that returns early when a copy would not fit.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type        | Description       |
| :-------- | :---------- | :---------------- |
| `range1`  | `GridRange` | The first range.  |
| `range2`  | `GridRange` | The second range. |

## Returns

`boolean` — `true` when the sizes differ.

## Examples

### Comparing sizes

```javascript
const source = { startRowIndex: 0, endRowIndex: 2, startColumnIndex: 0, endColumnIndex: 2 };
const target = { startRowIndex: 0, endRowIndex: 3, startColumnIndex: 0, endColumnIndex: 2 };

nonGridRangeSameDimensions(source, target); // => true
```
